scenes.heading: Amazon Redshift Architecture (RA3 & Spectrum)
scenes.narration: Redshift is a cluster-based MPP warehouse, and RA3 plus Spectrum modernize how it handles storage and the data lake.

scenes.heading: The core components
bullets: Leader node: parses SQL, builds the plan, and coordinates compute nodes.
Compute nodes: split into slices that scan and process data in parallel.
RA3 nodes: separate compute from storage using managed storage on S3.
Redshift Spectrum: query data in S3 directly without loading it first.
scenes.narration: The leader node plans each query and distributes work to compute nodes. Every compute node is divided into slices that process data in parallel across the cluster. RA3 nodes decouple storage so you scale compute independently, while Spectrum lets you query the S3 data lake in place.

scenes.heading: How a query runs
scenes.narration: The leader node receives the SQL, optimizes it, and compiles execution code for the slices. Each slice scans its portion of the data at the same time as the others. The leader then gathers the partial results and returns the final answer to the client.

scenes.heading: Classic DC2 vs modern RA3
scenes.narration: Older DC2 nodes bundle storage and compute, so growing one forces you to over-provision the other. RA3 moves data to Redshift Managed Storage on S3 and caches hot blocks locally. That lets you size compute for performance while storage grows on its own.

scenes.heading: Querying the lake with Spectrum
scenes.code:
-- Define an external schema over the S3 data lake
CREATE EXTERNAL SCHEMA lake
  FROM DATA CATALOG DATABASE 'analytics'
  IAM_ROLE 'arn:aws:iam::123:role/spectrum';

-- Join warehouse tables to S3 data in place
SELECT c.name, SUM(e.amount)
FROM customers c
JOIN lake.events e ON e.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name;
scenes.narration: First we create an external schema that maps to tables cataloged over S3. The query then joins a local Redshift table directly to that external data without ever loading it. Spectrum pushes the scan down to serverless workers, so you analyze the lake and the warehouse together in one statement.

scenes.text: Redshift is MPP with a leader and slices; RA3 separates storage and Spectrum extends queries to the S3 lake.
scenes.narration: Think leader plus parallel slices, RA3 for independent scaling, and Spectrum to reach the data lake without copying it.
